AMIStatus.description: AMIStatus compares the AMI that a nodegroup runs with the latest recommended AMI for its Kubernetes version and AMI type.

name.description: name identifies the item. For a Region failure it is the region.

cluster.description: cluster is the cluster that the item belongs to.

operation.description: operation is the IAM action that failed, such as "eks:DescribeNodegroup".

retryable.description: retryable reports whether the same command, run again with no other change, may succeed.

error.description: error is one line of text for people. Do not parse it; use Reason.

awsErrorCode.description: awsErrorCode is the AWS API error code, such as AccessDeniedException, when AWS answered.

updateId.description: updateId is the EKS update ID, for a failure of a started update.

Failure.description: Failure is one item that refresh could not read, or one action that it tried and that did not complete.

FailureKind.description: FailureKind is the type of item a Failure is about.

Failures.description: Failures is the failure list of a document. A nil list encodes as [], so a document always has its failures key as a list.

state.description: state is the EC2 instance state, such as running.

Instance.description: Instance is an EC2 instance of a nodegroup.

Issue.description: Issue is a health issue that EKS reports for a resource.

status.description: status is the EKS status, such as ACTIVE or UPDATING.

version.description: version is the Kubernetes minor version of the nodegroup.

versionBehind.description: versionBehind is true when the nodegroup runs an older minor version than the control plane. It is left out when one of the two versions is not known.

amiType.description: amiType is the EKS AMI type, such as AL2023_x86_64_STANDARD.

releaseVersion.description: releaseVersion is the AMI release version of the nodegroup.

capacityType.description: capacityType is the EKS capacity type, such as ON_DEMAND or SPOT.

healthIssues.description: healthIssues are the issues that EKS reports for the nodegroup.

instances.description: instances are the EC2 instances of the nodegroup, in a document that reads them.

readyNodes.description: readyNodes is the number of Ready nodes, from the Kubernetes API, in a document that reads it with --check-readiness.

workloads.description: workloads is what runs on the nodes, from the Kubernetes API, in a document that reads it with --show-workloads.

incomplete.description: incomplete is true when part of the nodegroup could not be read. Its failures are in the failures list of the document.

Nodegroup.description: Nodegroup is one EKS managed nodegroup. A key is left out when its data was not read: a nodegroup that could not be described has its name and incomplete.

current.description: current is the ID of the AMI that the nodes run. It is left out for a nodegroup with no instance to read.

latest.description: latest is the ID of the latest recommended AMI. It is left out for an AMI type that has none.

currentCreatedAt.description: currentCreatedAt is when the current AMI was created. "refresh status" reads it for an outdated AMI.

NodegroupAMI.description: NodegroupAMI is the AMI of a nodegroup and how it compares with the latest recommended one.

Scaling.description: Scaling is the scaling configuration of a nodegroup.

pods.description: pods is the number of pods on the nodes, Succeeded pods left out.

systemPods.description: systemPods is the number of them in kube-system.

Workloads.description: Workloads is what runs on the nodes of a nodegroup.

apiVersion.description: The version of the document contract.

failures.description: Every failure of the run: the items that refresh could not read and the actions that did not complete. The list is sorted by kind, region, cluster, name, and operation. It is [] when there are no failures.

title: NodegroupDescription
description: The document that `refresh nodegroup describe -o json` prints. -o yaml prints the same structure.
